title: Minimum Liability Limits by Ordering State: Cardinal SR-22 and FR-44 Certificates
content:
For each certificate of the Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing, the auto policy the certificate certifies must carry liability limits at least equal to the figures below for the ordering state. Limits are written as bodily injury per person / bodily injury per accident / property damage, in USD.

## Underwriting limits schedule

| Certificate | Ordering state | Minimum limits (BI per person / BI per accident / PD), USD |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal SR-22 Owner Certificate and Cardinal SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | OH | 25000/50000/25000 |
| | IN | 25000/50000/25000 |
| | KY | 25000/50000/25000 |
| | VA | 50000/100000/25000 |
| | WV | 25000/50000/25000 |
| Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate and Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | TN | 25000/50000/25000 |
| | MI | 50000/100000/10000 |
| | IL | 25000/50000/20000 |
| | MO | 25000/50000/25000 |
| Cardinal FR-44 Owner Certificate and Cardinal FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | VA | 100000/200000/50000 |

The owner and owner-operator versions of each certificate share the same figures.

## Reading the figures

Each of the three figures is a separate minimum: the policy's bodily injury per person limit, its bodily injury per accident limit and its property damage limit must each be at least the corresponding figure. A limit equal to the figure meets it.

**Hypothetical check.** A policy with limits of 50000/100000/25000 meets the Virginia figures for the in-state SR-22 certificates (50000/100000/25000), but not the Virginia figures for the FR-44 certificates (100000/200000/50000). A policy with 25000/50000/10000 meets the Michigan figures for the out-of-state SR-22 certificates in property damage (10000) but not in bodily injury (50000/100000). These policies are hypothetical.
